segments.name: Seniors Housing Operating
products: Independent living and independent supportive living
Care homes with or without nursing (U.K.)
segments.description: Owns seniors and wellness housing communities managed by operating partners under incentive-based contracts, serving older adults across the U.S., U.K. and Canada.
segments.evidence: Our Seniors Housing Operating properties include wellness housing, independent living and independent supportive living, continuing care retirement communities, assisted living, Alzheimer's/dementia care and include care homes with or without nursing (U.K.)

segments.name: Triple-net
products: Independent living and independent supportive living (Canada)
Care homes with or without nursing (U.K.)
segments.description: Leases seniors housing and long-term/post-acute care properties to operators under long-term triple-net master leases, with tenants paying all operating costs.
segments.evidence: Our Triple-net properties are primarily leased to operators under long-term, triple-net master leases that obligate the tenant to pay all operating costs, utilities, real estate taxes, insurance, maintenance costs and all obligations under certain ground leases.

segments.name: Outpatient Medical
segments.description: Owns outpatient medical buildings triple-net leased to investment grade healthcare providers, largely affiliated with health systems.
segments.evidence: Our remaining outpatient medical portfolio, exclusive of held for sale properties, primarily consists of triple-net leased properties leased to investment grade healthcare providers.

revenueModel.text: Welltower earns resident fees and services revenue from seniors housing residents and rental income from tenants under triple-net and outpatient medical leases, plus interest income.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary sources of revenue include resident fees and services revenue, rental income, interest income and interest earned on short-term deposits.
